gems.name: google-iam-v1beta
gems.info:
Manages identity and access control for Google Cloud Platform resources, including the creation of service accounts, which you can use to authenticate to Google and make API calls.

Note: This API is tied to the IAM service account credentials API (iamcredentials.googleapis.com). Enabling or disabling this API will also enable or disable the IAM service account credentials API.
Note that google-iam-v1beta is a version-specific client library. For most uses, we recommend installing the main client library google-iam instead. See the readme for more details.
